maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset management fees on managed investment strategies, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from institutional and individual investors and fund clients in its equity and fixed income strategies, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through investment strategies and client assets; it was itself acquired by First Eagle Investments.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can redeem or move investment mandates to other asset managers fairly easily; no regulatory approval or downtime.

notes: Diamond Hill is now part of First Eagle Investments, per its website.
